_comment: REAL-LAB GROUND TRUTH TEMPLATE. Copy this to data/ground_truth.json and replace every value with what you actually launched. Keys starting with '_' are notes for you and are ignored by the dashboard. Do NOT click 'Regenerate' in the sidebar while using real data — it overwrites data/ground_truth.json with mock facts.
_required_fields: Each campaign needs: attack_type, source_ip, start_time, end_time, malicious_attempts. The benign block needs benign_events. Everything else (target_ip, mitre_techniques, notes) is optional and only documents the run.
_time_format: ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-07-01T10:00:00.000+0000. Use the attacker box clock in UTC; the dashboard matches alerts whose src_ip + timestamp fall inside [start_time, end_time].

campaigns._attempts_help: Ports probed (from nmap output). attack_logs.parse_nmap can compute this for you.
Total login tries (the 'N of M' in hydra output). attack_logs.parse_hydra can compute this.
Packets/requests sent (from hping3/slowhttptest summary), or your best measured count.
Number of exploit/payload requests you sent.

benign._benign_help: Size of the benign (negative) population during the test window — i.e. how many legitimate events could have alerted but should not. Measure it from a quiet baseline capture (see docs/RUNBOOK.md Step 3). This scales TN and FPR; state your method in the dissertation's threats-to-validity.
